description: Registry of the Figma sources of design truth. The Design role syncs published variables/components from these into design/tokens/ via the Figma MCP.

studio810-foundation.name: Studio 810 — DS-001 Foundation
studio810-foundation.scopeHint: Single Foundation page (0:1). All content is studio810.* scope. Placeholder neutral palette until the Studio 810 brand palette is defined.
studio810-foundation.contains: studio810 design system foundation: four variable collections (color, radius, space, type), each single-mode 'Light', totalling 12 variables, and one component.

Button/Primary.variants: none — single component with a Label text property; variants TBD
Button/Primary.bindings: fills, all four corner radii, all four paddings, fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight are bound to studio810 variables
